data.notes: February 2027 is Carnival month in Port of Spain, with the confirmed calendar concentrated around soca fetes, J’Ouvert, Panorama steelpan, and the Feb. 8–9 road climax.

events.title: Trinidad Carnival 2027
events.venueName: Port of Spain streets / Queen's Park Savannah
events.summary: Official tourism listing confirms Trinidad’s Carnival road days for Monday, February 8 and Tuesday, February 9, 2027. Expect masquerade bands, soca and calypso sound systems, and the main Port of Spain street parade atmosphere.

events.title: Soca Brainwash Music Festival: A Pirate’s Tale
events.summary: DJ Private Ryan’s Soca Brainwash is confirmed for Carnival Saturday, February 6, at St Mary's Grounds. The listing gives the 2027 theme as “A Pirate’s Tale.”

events.title: LIME: The Ultimate Carnival Fete
events.summary: Hyatt LIME is confirmed for February 3, 2027 at Hyatt Regency Trinidad. The official page describes the all-inclusive Carnival Wednesday fete with soca, calypso and chutney entertainment, premium food and waterfront production.

events.title: National Panorama 2027 — Large Conventional Band Finals
events.venueName: Grand & North Stands, Queen's Park Savannah
events.summary: Pan Trinbago confirms the Large Conventional Band Finals of National Panorama 2027 for February 6 at Queen’s Park Savannah. This is the flagship steelpan competition night of the Carnival season.

events.title: IZ WE 2027: Roots, Rock, Soca — We Coming Home
events.summary: Kes The Band’s Carnival-season cultural concert is confirmed at Queen’s Park Savannah, with the listing describing a Main Stage headlined by Kes and additional artists and DJs.

events.title: TRIBE Ignite — Olympia 2027
events.summary: TRIBE Carnival confirms its Ignite Olympia fete for Carnival Thursday from February 4 into February 5. The listing promises soca artistes, top DJs, premium drinks and a white/gold/silver dress code.

events.title: Dimanche Gras — Senior Kings and Queens Finals 2027
events.summary: The National Carnival Commission calendar confirms Dimanche Gras Senior Kings and Queens Finals for February 7 at Carnival City, Queen’s Park Savannah. It is the major Carnival Sunday stage event before J’Ouvert and the road days.

events.title: A.M.BEACH CLUB '27
events.summary: Caesar’s Army confirms A.M.BEACH CLUB for Carnival Thursday, February 4. The listing describes a North Coast beach-club experience with soca, premium drinks, Caribbean cuisine and local/international DJs.

events.title: AWOL TT 2027
events.summary: AWOL’s Carnival Thursday cooler cruise is confirmed for February 4 at Harts Cut, Chaguaramas. The event page lists 9:00 AM boarding and 10:00 AM sailing.

events.title: Citrus Trinidad Carnival 2027
events.summary: Illusions, Private Ryan and Radiance Productions list this premium all-inclusive tropical Carnival Wednesday fete at Green Meadows in nearby Santa Cruz. The event page highlights DJs, Caribbean food and premium drinks.

events.title: WE J'ouvert Band
events.summary: WE J’ouvert confirms its all-inclusive band will touch road from the heart of Port of Spain on Carnival Monday, February 8, 2027. The package includes a soca music truck, breakfast, drinks, paint, powder, water truck and security.

events.title: DJ JEL: Jus'so Fete 2027 — The Night Market
events.summary: DJ JEL’s Jus'so Fete is confirmed at SoundForge Woodbrook from February 3 into February 4. The food-inclusive night market concept pairs Trinidadian food, drinks and soca in Port of Spain.

events.title: Carnival Lagniappe — 2027 Champs
events.summary: Pan Trinbago lists Carnival Lagniappe — 2027 Champs for February 13 at the Grand Stand, Queen’s Park Savannah. The post-Carnival steelpan event presents the 2027 champions under the National Panorama banner.

events.title: Hennessy Pure White 2027
events.summary: Harbour Master lists Pure White 2027 for February 4, presented with Lyrikal and Viking Ding Dong. It is billed as a premium all-white Carnival boatride.

events.title: Frolic: Rhythm of Our People
events.venueName: Fete Yard, Queen's Hall, St. Ann's
events.summary: Frolic returns on Carnival Friday at Fete Yard, Queen’s Hall, from February 5 into February 6. The listing describes a food-inclusive cooler fete with performances from major soca names.

events.title: IMAGINE 'Jouvert Gems'
events.summary: DJ Private Ryan presents a Carnival Sunday evening J’ouvert-style experience built around paint, oil, mud, powder, water and riddim.

events.title: J'lime Trinidad Carnival 2027
events.summary: Pumpers Inc confirms J’lime at Mille Fleurs from February 3 into February 4. The listing bills it as a premium drinks-inclusive soca event with gourmet tapas and live up-close performances.

events.title: Hard Fete — Fete Harder!
events.summary: Hard Fete is confirmed in Port of Spain from February 5 into February 6. The event page bills it directly as a power-soca experience.

events.title: Lime at the Hyatt
events.summary: All-white Carnival-week all-inclusive fete listed as a Platinum-ticket upgrade for Ultimate Trinidad Carnival 2027, positioned as an early-week premium diaspora/soca kickoff before the main road days.

events.title: Sahara J’ouvert 27
events.summary: Orange-themed J’ouvert road party in Woodbrook promising Jamaican DJs, paint, drinks, and Carnival Monday road energy from midnight to morning.

events.title: Sunny Side Up Breakfast Party
events.summary: Confirmed as the Sunday all-inclusive breakfast fete in the Ultimate Trinidad Carnival 2027 package, Sunny Side Up fits the sunrise/breakfast-party lane that anchors Carnival-week fete culture.

events.title: Phuket All-Inclusive
events.summary: A Friday Carnival-week all-inclusive fete included in the Ultimate Trinidad Carnival 2027 premium experience, geared toward the food-and-drinks-inclusive soca/fete circuit rather than arena programming.
